content.v: 《GTA6》编剧谈到了露西亚与杰森的角色设计：两人都有脆弱、强韧和有缺点的一面，会犯错，也能从彼此身上学习。LOVE Magazine在即将推出的刊物前分享了创作团队的部分访谈。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790976622_375230_jpg_r.jpg
R星叙事高级副总裁Rupert Humphries表示，露西亚想为自己争取更好的生活，不会被障碍挡住。编剧Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern说，团队希望露西亚和杰森有时能判断正确，有时也会犯错；这些特质让两人显得可信，也使他们成为合适的搭档。另一位编剧Alexa D’Agostino认为，写出角色各自的愿望，能让他们呈现出虽带有俗套、却仍显真实的不完美之处。
Humphries将两人比作现代版的邦妮和克莱德。他说团队要创造一个映照当代的世界，就需要让它比现实更夸张、更疯狂、更直白。亡命奔逃、暂不顾后果地将犯罪行动推向极限，也带着某种充满希望的天真感。
这种处境也与游戏机制有关：警察会识别角色并持续追捕，玩家可能需要换车、换衣服摆脱追踪。当地不少人装备精良，主角的个人力量因此显得更受限制。
谈到“美国梦”，Humphries认为如今它或许只是为家人拥有一所房子并还清贷款，而非取得巨大的成功。在他看来，南佛罗里达正是这种追求发生碰撞的前沿。

items.title: 人工智能与教皇的争执：简要回顾
items.summary: The pope took on 'AI art' this week, saying that "there is an ontological difference ... between art and what

content.v: For a while now, AI guys have been arguing with the pope—Bishop of Rome, Primate of Italy, Chicago White Sox fan—over whether or not their chatbots and image generators are consistent with the will of the Lord, and in one recently-revealed exchange, whether making a computer talk constitutes creating life.
According to a New York Times report published this week, Anthropic lobbied the pope's advisers "to take the prospect of AI model consciousness seriously" back in May.

The pope, apparently unmoved, stated in his Magnifica Humanitas that "so-called artificial intelligences do not undergo experiences, do not possess a body, do not feel joy or pain, do not mature through relationships and do not know from within what love, work, friendship or responsibility mean."
Former White House technology adviser Dean Ball criticized the pope's letter at the time, saying it "puts the Church into the awkward role of the European technocratic regulatory advocate."
Ball is now head of strategic futures at OpenAI.
The latest in this ongoing beef between the pope and AI boosters is a new anti-slop message from His Holiness posted on X this week .

"In this era of artificial intelligence, it is becoming urgent to distinguish human art from what machines produce," wrote the pope. "There is an ontological difference, even before an aesthetic one, between art and what a machine can generate through statistical calculation based on millions of images created by others. Algorithms lack the spark of humanity. For this reason, the Church wishes to renew an alliance with artists and cultural institutions to safeguard our humanity."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zBnN6yftKNaf8xygeDumze-1920-80.jpg

Even on X, ruled as it is by the dunce king of tech and his Grok-riddled followers, there is a lot of support for the pope's stance. But of course there are also AI evangelists intent on schooling the Holy See about the beauty of "super intelligence," as it has been dubbed by people who must lack conviction in their own.
In one response I saw pointed out on Bluesky , the pope is asked "What about the Minions?" Indeed... what about them?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BWi3Qg96wjXHHjSHmpM3ji-1920-80.png

With the battle lines drawn between powerful AI interests and the Catholic church, will the next Great Schism be over whether or not Claude is a real person? Will an AI thoughtleader ascend to pope-like status of their own?

An event like that wouldn't be out of place in '90s cyberpunk-comedy novel Snow Crash . I'd once assumed that those satirical visions of mad techno-cultists and lawless megacorps would manifest in a somehow more buttoned-up way, more 'realistically.' I gravely misjudged reality's capacity for farce.

A tangentially-related case-in-point: Palmer Luckey, the guy who invented the first decent consumer VR headset, is now a weapons mogul with a personal UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter . Deus Ex bosses are real, and they wear Hawaiian shirts.

content.v: 《皇牌空战8：特维之翼》团队回应了预购赠品《皇牌空战零：贝尔卡战争》在Steam无法独立启动的问题。该赠品在XSX|S和PS5上可以单独启动，但在Steam上与《皇牌空战8：特维之翼》绑定，并非独立应用。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790976700_972724_jpg_r.jpg
团队随后在Steam发文解释，受授权限制及平台方面的考虑，目前无法将赠品作为独立应用在Steam发布。团队也为事先没有清楚说明分发方式、造成玩家困惑和不满道歉。
对于后续安排，团队表示正在评估可能的处理方式，并与平台 合作 方沟通，但无法保证最终会作出更改。
《皇牌空战8：特维之翼》于9月28日开启抢先体验，10月1日正式发售。事件发生时，其Steam用户评价为“多半好评”。InsiderGaming援引SteamDB数据称，该作Steam历史同时在线峰值已超过3.7万人，高于《皇牌空战7》不足1.4万人的峰值。

items.title: 迪士尼表示“现在”并未进行有关购买 Epic 游戏的讨论
items.summary: Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/04/30/1-1777571355989.jpg
Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games.

Disney president and chief creative officer Dana Walden touched on the company's relationship with Epic during an interview with Bloomberg Live . When asked if there have been talks about expanding their previously established relationship with a full-on acquisition, she said that strategy isn't something Disney is entertaining, at least right now.

"Well, I think that it was pretty obvious that we had very serious conversations about an investment and an equity stake," Walden responded. "Those are not the conversations we're having right now, but we have a great partnership and a number of launches coming up over the next two years that are going to demonstrate the value of this partnership."

The relationship referenced here was solidified when Disney announced it acquired a $1.5 billion stake in Epic back in early 2024. It was a massive play that it promised would result in collaborations across Fortnite and more in the future.

"Our exciting new relationship with Epic Games will bring together Disney’s beloved brands and franchises with the hugely popular Fortnite in a transformational new games and entertainment universe," then-CEO Bob Iger said. "This marks Disney’s biggest entry ever into the world of games and offers significant opportunities for growth and expansion. We can’t wait for fans to experience the Disney stories and worlds they love in groundbreaking new ways."

We're still feeling the shockwaves of that deal, but some suspected it could evolve into more than a simple partnership. Tech reporter Alex Heath said in March 2026 that some Disney executives were "waiting for that moment" to go all in on an acquisition . Then, in April, Bloomberg reported that Epic was working on an extraction shooter featuring Disney characters with plans to launch in November 2026.

We're now kicking off October with no official mention of that unannounced project, but that doesn't mean Disney x Epic is going anywhere any time soon. While an acquisition isn't in the cards, Walden's promise regarding "a number of launches" set to arrive in the next few years suggests there is plenty more to talk about.

We'll have to wait and see how the two entertainment giants work together moving forward. In the meantime, you can read some of the other ways Disney and Epic have bolstered their relationship, including a Disneyland-exclusive Fortnite skin and officially licensed Star Wars minigames .

items.title: 我一直对万代南梦宫即将推出的高达游戏持怀疑态度，但后来我看到了这个模型套件的电锯 macuahuitl
items.summary: It's a compelling argument.

content.v: Doctors have confirmed it: It's physically impossible for me to turn my nose up at a mecha action game. But despite this dire prognosis, I've been suspicious of Gundam Rogue Orbit—Bandai Namco's mobile suit action game coming in spring—since it was announced back in June .

The problem is the giant monsters. I'm a Gundam traditionalist. Gundam, to me, isn't about fighting aliens—it's about traumatized child war pilots becoming so psychic that their brains explode. But this week, Bandai found a way to coax me off my high horse: With an extremely sick model kit.
【全日本ホビーショー 情報解禁＆初展示✨】HG 1/144 バウバラム 情報解禁！ガンダムゲーム最新作『GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT』より、バウバラムがHGシリーズで登場！！ホビーサイトでの続報をお待ちください！https://t.co/XoaJUr7vZa#ガンプラ #プラモデル pic.twitter.com/Y780tB7BUE October 2, 2026

My time at PC Gamer has coincided with my steady descent into Gundam model kit obsession: I'm currently at the stage of manually re-scribing mold lines, so the outlook is grim. As a result, I was particularly prone to react when yesterday, as part of its reveal lineup for the 2026 All Japan Model & Hobby Show, Bandai announced the HG 1/144 Bau Bahlam—a model kit incarnation of a mobile suit we'll see in Rogue Orbit. Look at this thing:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UYonKCRTJkbokJk4Xw9kJW-1920-80.jpg

The Bau Bahlam was briefly visible in Rogue Orbit's release date trailer back in September, but these model kit renders are the first time I've properly taken in the design. Here's what jumps out at me:

It's impressively menacing, and—if the mecha customization shown in the release date trailer is any indication—we'll probably be able to use its various bits on our own robot. Hopefully that includes the macuahuitl. It'd be cruel not to.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WtHRDdxBxFP4kq7xFSxo94-1920-80.jpg

I still reserve the right to be obnoxious about Rogue Orbit's departure from the traditional Gundam conceptual palette once it actually launches, but rolling out impressive mecha designs like these is an effective way of softening me up in the meantime. Surely, a game willing to give its robots giant Mesoamerican chainswords has to have its heart in the right place.
Gundam Rogue Orbit launches on Steam on March 4, 2027. The HG 1/144 Bau Bahlam kit doesn't have a release date, but it's expected to be available sometime in 2027.

content.v: 近日Riot Games联合创始人Marc Merrill接受采访，谈及《英雄联盟》MMO时承认开发这类游戏有不少难题，但团队仍愿意尝试。他认为，符文之地已有庞大的玩家基础，许多玩家熟悉这个世界，希望能在其中生活。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790973993_369981_jpg_r.jpg
Merrill在Lemonade Stand播客中表示，外界对项目的担忧有根据。MMO开发规模庞大，玩家期待高，受众也常被认为相对有限。提问者还谈到，部分资深玩家随着年龄增长，可支配的游玩时间减少，市场上已有《魔兽世界》等大型作品。Merrill说，认为团队不该开发这款游戏，确实有许多看起来合理的理由。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790973994_677934_jpg_r.jpg
他同时指出，Riot长期建设符文之地，全球已有大量玩家熟悉并喜爱其中的角色、阵营和世界。公司也拥有玩家基础、收入来源和开发团队。他说，玩家希望生活在这个世界中，团队希望提供这样的体验。
Riot另一款游戏《2XKO》已宣布停止积极开发，这也让部分玩家对MMO的前景保持谨慎。谈到项目本身，Merrill认为关键在于做出配得上《英雄联盟》这一知识产权的作品；如果试图满足所有人，游戏可能因过度折中而失去明确方向。

items.title: Vibe-Coded Mashup Mods 本周已占据 X 市场
items.summary: I have spent the last three days scrolling through some of the most insane mod videos I've ever seen. Modders

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/vibecodedmods-explainer-blogroll-1790975025611.jpg

I have spent the last three days scrolling through some of the most insane mod videos I've ever seen. Modders are taking games that have been decompiled with Claude, and mashing them up with other games. As the week has gone on, there have only been more clips of these mods pouring out on X/Twitter.

One person created a mashup of World of Warcraft and Call of Duty: World at War ; another combined Escape From Tarkov with Skyrim . There’s even one that takes Insomniac’s Spider-Man and combines it with Batman Arkham City , where the player is able to swing around Batman’s turf.

These mods are everywhere online right now, though they thankfully haven’t filtered into modding websites like Nexus Mods yet. But, with the sheer volume of these mods and with how accessible Opus 5.5 is, it feels like it’s only a matter of time before the gates are fully torn down. And if that happens, it could change the face of the modding scene entirely.
Why Now?

Claude Opus 5.5 launched last week, promising cheaper tokens and more efficient code work. I'm sure that Anthropic meant for it to be used by professionals, but gamers have used it to create some of the weirdest mods I have ever seen.

Opus is a model that can power AI agents, which can be deployed to create entire games from the engine, to the art and enemy behavior. Brendan Jowett has a great video on YouTube of the model in action: He develops little slices of video games and compares them directly with the same tasks from OpenAI’s Astra 6 model. While the results of both are far from what you’d expect from a fully featured game, Claude’s new model has clearly come a long way.

The problem with the examples in Jowett’s video is that while the models are good at piecing together disparate parts of a game, enemy AI (lol) and art assets are lackluster to say the least. In one of the slices, a space combat sim, the space fighter flys at a diagonal angle, while moving in a straight line ahead, and shooting. In another slice enemies completely ignore the player character.

As good as Claude Opus 5.5 seems to be, it’s still lightyears away from developing something like a true mashup of Minecraft and Elden Ring from scratch. But the model doesn’t have to start from scratch.

The big, driving force behind a lot of these mods is decompilation, where people are pointing Opus at a game and letting the agent break it down to its source code (here’s a handy blog if you want to really get in the weeds). Just earlier today, we covered Halo: Combat Evolved being decompiled and ported to run natively in a browser . Once that step is complete, it takes little effort to take that source code and work huge swaths of games into other games as mods, and with very little input from the user.

Couple that with the relatively affordable tokens, and it shouldn’t be surprising that X/Twitter’s generally pro-AI users went wild with it, creating hundreds of mashups. And it doesn’t seem like it’s slowing down any time soon; what started off as a weird video that my boss sent me on Tuesday has now evolved to the point where I can’t even open X/Twitter without seeing a deluge of these mods.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/18/likeadragonhawaii-blogroll-1739839417413.jpg
Piracy?

The obvious problem with all of this is that these models are breaking open games developed by real people, getting the source code and then just mashing stuff together without consideration or permission from the original developers. That’s nothing particularly new – the modding scene is definitely no stranger to mashups, all the Thomas the Tank Engine mods are proof of that. However, this trend might be breaking into new territory, thanks to decompilation.

This could be another reason none of these mods have made their way onto any distribution platforms. Nexus Mods doesn’t outright ban AI-generated content, but it doesn’t let people use AI tools to upload content that they don’t have the rights to.

In a blog post from 2023, Nexus laid out its rules around AI generated content. The policy states that , “In order to prevent any issues with your mods, we encourage you to avoid using these tools unless you have explicit permission to use all the assets. This is particularly true for AI-generated voice acting but also covers images, models, code and anything else that you can use this technology to create.”

Every single one of these passthrough mods are using images, models, and code that the people generating them don’t have the rights to. But it’s only a matter of time until some platform holder allows these mods to be hosted, and I’m sure a massive legal battle will happen immediately afterwards.
The Modding Community Hates This

Way before all of these Claude-authored mod videos started cropping up online, people had been creating mods by hand for years, typically out of pure love for the game. It shouldn’t be surprising, then, that a lot of mod authors aren’t fans of this phenomenon.

Mod authors have been expressing their frustration on X/Twitter as this has been happening. “I mod games and I'm not shy about the fact that I use AI to do it. I hate this bullshit ‘trend’. Pure slop, there's nothing creative about this at all,” kran27_ posted. “AI has a lot of potential in the modding scene, but the shit that's getting the clicks is this jingling keys bullshit.”

Kran wasn’t alone, with discountmodder ready to just leave the scene, saying, “Dude I'm really disappointed. If this becomes the permanent state of modding, this may be my last project. I don't wanna be involved in an AI slop-factory.”

I can’t escape the feeling that most of these mashups are born from people just playing with a new AI model and seeing what will happen, and I hope that this weird trend will die off soon. Modding is one of the best parts of PC gaming, and there is a lot of incredible content that people make just because they love a game. Some of the best games started off as mods, after all, and without them we never would have got the likes of Half-Life or League of Legends.

I hope that this is just a trend, rather than a sign of where the modding scene is heading. Fortunately, because these mods seemingly only exist to farm engagement on Twitter (at least so far), you don’t have to worry too much about them if you just want to start a new modded run of The Witcher 3 Remastered. If anything, it just means that if you want to avoid AI content, you need to pay even more attention to who you’re getting your mods from.

items.title: 30年后，他们终于让《皇牌空战》的导演驾驶真正的喷气式飞机，我很荣幸
items.summary: This is what a man looks like after fulfilling a lifelong dream.

content.v: Kazutoki Kono: You're welcome.

Back in June , I asked the Ace Combat brand director, who's been working on the series since 1997's Ace Combat 2, if he'd ever gotten to strap into an F-16 and experience the real thrills of doing barrel rolls at 30,000 feet. "Unfortunately over the last 30 years of my career I've been appealing, saying 'hey, we want to ride in one of these jets!' but we have not yet had the chance," Kono said at the time. "Neither myself, or anyone on the team."

Mere months later, it's a whole new world. In a promotional video released today alongside Ace Combat 8, Bandai Namco revealed that Kono finally got to climb into the cockpit of a jet and live the real life version of the series he's been overseeing for years and years. Well, minus the combat parts.

"I was scared before getting in. But once we were airborne, it turned into one of the most beautiful experiences," he said in the video. "The G-force during turns was noticeable, but what stood out the most was the force pushing me downward into the seat. Being up in the sky inside such a compact cockpit felt incredible. It was a surprisingly comfortable and enjoyable space to be in. Compared to a large aircraft, it really made me appreciate the appeal of fighter jets."

One way to look at this sequence of events is to see the ad as a logical and inevitable marketing step for a series that Bandai Namco has clearly put more money behind than ever before, including a live-action YouTube miniseries . The other way to look at it—as I'm choosing to—is that the public outcry after my groundbreaking interview was published reached a level of fervor that simply could not be ignored. It may have only gotten one comment on pcgamer.com , but the ripples must've been felt all the way over in Tokyo.

Clearly the people demanded Kazutoki Kono be given the chance to soar that big blue sky, and the money men had no choice but to pay for our guy to hitch a ride in a MiG-21. Whatever it cost, it was clearly worth it. Look at Kono in his post-flight interview. He's glowing!
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qWy6Uv5qcGu2bEC2imd37P-1920-80.jpg

That's the look of a man who's just had his dream fulfilled. And even after having just experienced the wonder of flight at a speed and intimacy few on this earth will ever know themselves, he remained steadfast in his duty as brand director.
"Looking out at the clouds and the sky while flying, I couldn't help but think how Ace Combat is incredibly well-made," he said. No argument here .

items.title: GTA 6 截图表明它不会羞于引用电影
items.summary: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be refer

content.v: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be referencing the iconic opening scene from Quentin Tarantino's 1994 crime movie Pulp Fiction.

The image was shared by Love magazine on Instagram . The GTA 6 Countdown social media account put it next to the diner scene from Pulp Fiction, and the similarities are there, especially in the framing.

In Pulp Fiction, Tim Roth and Amanda Plummer's characters, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny, go on to rob the diner, and given that Lucia and Jason are criminals as well, it's not a stretch to think that could happen in GTA 6. Maybe they're just enjoying breakfast, but that seems unlikely given the image clearly shows both gripping their pistols, with Lucia seemingly ready to fill the empty duffel bag next to her with cash and other valuables.

GTA 6 tells a Bonnie and Clyde-style story of two lovers who are also criminals. Things did not end well for them, and many are speculating as to how GTA 6's story could wrap up for both Lucia and Jason. It also wouldn't be surprising to see GTA 6 reference Pulp Fiction given how GTA games in the past have featured very overt references to movies, like how Vice City had Scarface references and GTA 5 had nods to Heat.

"We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other,”GTA 6 writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern told Love magazine. “That’s what we felt made them authentic, and a great team.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_13_0038a1.jpg?w=636

Another GTA 6 game writer, Alexa D’Agostino, told the magazine, “When you are focusing on writing a fully realized person with their own wants, you’re going to get something perfectly imperfect--with clichés, but also undeniably real.”

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. On November 18, the Miami Heat will wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys and play on a court that references Vice City, the game's setting, and a stand-in for Miami.
GTA 6 will take players outside of Miami to other places in Florida, just don't expect to go to Rockstar's version of Walt Disney World .

items.summary: Bungie is 'building a new home for our merchandise that's more aligned with our current goals and vision,' and

content.v: Another unexpected twist in the Bungle tale:

After more than a decade of serving our players through the Bungie Store, we are retiring the current storefront for Bungie and Destiny related merchandise on October 19. We are building a new home for our merchandise that's more aligned with our current goals and vision. We'll… October 2, 2026

That's the latest move from Bungie, which recently un-cancelled Destiny 2 following a massive fan backlash over the decision to put the game in maintenance mode. It seems odd to me—I would think that now, with the seeming rebirth of Destiny 2 at hand, is exactly the time you'd want that storefront up and operational. Regardless of the need for a new storefront, taking the old one offline for months while it's being made feels counterproductive.

Also interesting is that the Marathon storefront, which lives on its own subdomain , is not being taken offline while the "new home" is being built. They look effectively identical, so I have no idea what to make of that.
Here's a little comparison of the two:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/h2UGhQZi8XtQxnD6aXGxWU-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tdYJDVq25Q9oEJrdX6JTPU-1920-80.png

At a guess, I'd say the most likely outcome here is that the Bungie Store will be integrated into Sony's own storefront—rather like Bungie's own absorption into Sony after the wheels came off the whole "independent subsidiary" thing.

Some followers hope that will lead to lower shipping costs, which would be a positive outcome of sorts, although Sony taking control of the whole endeavor could mean a more limited selection of stuff going forward. That's entirely speculative, but that's also the whole Bungie/Destiny 2 situation in a nutshell: Something is happening, but exactly what we just cannot pin down at this point.
What we can pin down is that the Bungie Store as we know it will close on October 19, while digital downloads and emblem codes will remain accessible until December 31. Get 'em while you can.

items.title: 亲爱的前 NFL 主教练 Mike Tomlin：你的 12 年 Minecraft 城市很美丽
items.summary: It may or may not have contributed to the Steelers' years of postseason woes—but at least it's walkable.

content.v: By the time he stepped down as head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2025, Mike Tomlin—then the NFL's longest-tenured coach—had led the team through a 19-year run without a losing season, securing 13 playoff appearances, eight division titles, and a victory at Super Bowl XLIII.

Since 2014, however, Tomlin has been answering a higher calling: He's been building. In a YouTube video on Wednesday, he unveiled his true masterwork: A sprawling Minecraft metropolis that he's been meticulously hand-sculpting for the last 12 years. And it's magnificent.

As the video starts, Tomlin—PlayStation controller in hand—explains that he was introduced to Minecraft by his children, who were obsessed with the game during their middle school years. While he didn't have much history with videogames, he was "mesmerized by what could occupy their attention," and as he's "always had an interest in architecture," he naturally gravitated to Minecraft's creative mode.
Eventually, his kids moved on to other interests—but Tomlin remained transfixed by the "therapeutic" act of crafting buildings, communities, and neighborhoods.
"It allowed me to detach from the realities and pressures of life," Tomlin says. "Let's take you through it."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Kt7P5EdNDcLsn9konjTGkk-1920-80.png

The video then transitions to Tomlin's first-person view as he surveyed his works from on high, revealing the purest product of a grown man's hyperfixation I've ever seen: a waterfront district, with a bay surrounded by skyrises, hotels, and apartment blocks—each with its own color schemes, exterior detailing, balconies, courtyards, balustrades, awnings, and plazas.
"I started small," he says.

The former NFL coach then takes us on a tour of his city's first completed building, a "boutique hotel" built from cut red sandstone with marble and birchwood walkways, featuring—as Tomlin casually explains—a multi-floor executive spa with therapy rooms, a glass-ceilinged multi-purpose conference room, an indoor-outdoor restaurant with balcony seating, and "appropriate amenities" like public restrooms with sinks and stalls recreated from cleverly repurposed Minecraft fixtures.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rNx5qLzpsoU6NJqNY3FiQF-1920-80.png
It also has a basement speakeasy with a glowstone-illuminated window looking out into the hotel pool. With an adjacent employee area. And kitchen.

The tour continues through themed residential high rises-slash-aquariums with detailed bedroom interiors, past recreated CVS pharmacies, baseball fields, and soccer stadiums, and over rooftop penthouses. Throughout, Tomlin reiterates how he tried to consider both function and aesthetics by keeping conscious of interior lighting and what types of views building occupants would enjoy.

It's delightful —but it may not have been entirely delightful for the Steelers. Since he presented his city on Wednesday, many have noted that the years in which he would've been building his Minecraft magnum opus overlapped with the team's declining playoff performance .

From his first season as head coach in 2007 to 2013, the Steelers had a postseason win rate of 62.5%. Between Tomlin breaking ground on his Minecraft city in 2014 and stepping down as head coach in 2025, however, the team's postseason win rate was a mere 25%. During those years, the Steelers won only three playoff games, and suffered nine consecutive years without a playoff win.
It was also apparently a trying time for Tomlin's son Mayce, who had to endure his dad bogarting the PlayStation .
Bro I used to come home sometimes and my PlayStation would just be gone. And I wasn’t in trouble😭😭😭 https://t.co/sVMg1SqxCs October 1, 2026

Now, we can only speculate whether Minecraft actually played a role in the Steelers' playoff record—but even if it did, I think we can all agree the price was worth paying. Have you seen how many aquariums this town has? Coach, if you're reading: I'm ready to move in.

The initial showing of Tomlin's Minecraft city was only the first episode: He and his son Dino—who's been handling the video production of his dad's build showcase—evidently have more tour videos planned. It's unclear when we can expect the next, but you'll be able to find it on Tomlin's YouTube channel .

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/31/hrdxhdzwwaax1k-1788198129736.jpg
UPDATE October 2, 2026, 11:39 a.m. PT: PEGI has seemingly updated its website to remove the age rating for GTA 6.

The PEGI 18 page – which, as viewed by IGN, included what appeared to be new details about GTA 6 – is no longer available. In its place is a blank listing that says, "The requested page could not be found." Users on X/Twitter have captured and shared an image of the listing and have continued to share its contents across social media. IGN has reached out to PEGI for comment.
Grand Theft Auto VI PEGI rating is now up! https://t.co/av3HXd6GQf pic.twitter.com/6MhVcAA1xc
ORIGINAL STORY: GTA 6 has received an age rating of PEGI 18, revealing mentions of "decapitation," the ability for players to snort cocaine at any time, "scenes of sexual fetishes," and much more.

The update, which can be found on the Pan European Game Information board's website , gives players a relatively in-depth description of Rockstar Games' megaton video game ahead of its launch in November. The PEGI 18 rating arrives just one day after GTA 6 received its official ESRB rating , which, also unsurprisingly, resulted in an "M for Mature."

GTA 6's rating describes a story that allows players to take control of "Jason Duval or Lucia Caminos, two criminals who become involved in a criminal conspiracy following a failed robbery." It adds that they'll work together as "they become increasingly entangled in criminal activities" in Vice City, with gameplay that, as we've already seen, is par for the course when it comes to Grand Theft Auto.

What's different about GTA 6 is the unprecedented detail Rockstar has shoved into the game , with previous footage showing off an open-world sandbox with enough activities to make up for the 13-year wait. PEGI dived into that, too, but there are still even more new highlights to go over.

The board described the game's violence as "bloody with a high degree of realism." Some weapons will be more brutal than others, with some said to be "able to cause greater damage, such as detailed decapitation and dismemberment." This time around, Rockstar has made drug use "frequent and prominent," with players able to partake in illicit substances. Cocaine is said to be especially important in Vice City, with the rating promising that Jason and Lucia will be able to use the substance directly from their inventory, as it can be "snorted directly from their hand at any time."

The GTA 6 PEGI description also touched on " strong sexual themes ," which include "nudity, scenes of intercourse, and occasional scenes of sexual fetishes." It's a lot that we knew and some details that we didn't, but you can read the "content specific issues" section of the summary in its entirety below.

"This game contains frequent depictions of violence; due to the free roam nature of the game the player can harm all other characters inhabiting the environment," PEGI said. "This includes civilians, criminals and the authorities. Violence is bloody with a high degree of realism, with certain weapons being able to cause greater damage such as detailed decapitation and dismemberment.

"Drug use is frequent and prominent with the player being able to partake in drug use with others and to use illegal drugs directly from their inventory. Most notably, cocaine can be carried around by the player and snorted directly from their hand at any time.

"There are also strong sexual themes, including nudity, scenes of intercourse and occasional scenes of sexual fetishes. In various night clubs the player can also pay for private dances, during which, the game allows the player to move their hands onto the dancers’ breasts and buttocks."

The PEGI age rating also mentioned "other issues," including that domestic animals can be harmed, though not in the same detail as humans. The word "f**k" is also featured prominently in the game, while the word "c**t" is only occasionally featured. The description also said that "discriminatory language can be heard in the TV shows and on the radio channels."

Finally, GTA 6 reminds players that they will have the option to purchase in-game items, though it's still unclear what this entails. In August, it was reported that Rockstar would not include microtransactions or generative AI in the game .

GTA 6 is still on course to launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, 2026. You can read more about how Rockstar has ramped up its marketing tactics here , and you can see what we learned from some new screenshots here . While we wait for any more updates, you can read IGN's interview and preview .

items.title: 《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》中外战需要关注的 4 件事
items.titleEn: 4 Things to Focus on Outside Combat in Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/1-thumb-1790796752214.jpg

We’re back for a new installment in our The Long Game series, where we break down things you can invest in early in games that will pay off long-term. Today we’re focusing on Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave, the huge new installment in the long-running series that takes you to the capital of the Dagdan Empire to be a gladiator in the Heroic Games.

Like its predecessor Three Houses, Fortune’s Weave has a split narrative with multiple protagonists. However, this time around, you don’t have to choose one route. You can follow the stories of Cai, Leda, Dietrich, and Theodora in any order and can switch between them at any time once you reach Dagsion, the central hub city.

As with the rest of the Fire Emblem series, Fortune’s Weave is centered on grid-based strategy combat. But it also features a heavy focus on activities outside of combat, with access to a world map you can traverse between story battles. You can find dungeons, towns, traveling merchants, and skirmishes with roving enemies.

That’s on top of running around the giant city of Dagsion, which is full of shops, activities, and people to meet. It can all be a little overwhelming, especially if you’re new to the series and aren’t sure where to start. So that’s what we’re here to help with. Here are four things outside of combat that you can (and should) start taking advantage of as soon as you can.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/2-support-1790796279494.jpg
Show Your Support
支持级别和对话长期以来一直是《火焰之纹章》系列的主要内容，每当角色并肩作战或在战斗中提供治疗或支持时，他们都会积累积分。 《财富的编织》扩展了该系统，并添加了在战斗之外建立支持的新方法，您应该尽可能利用这些方法。
建立支持的主要方式是在旅馆里一起吃饭，所有主角在游戏初期都可以享用这些食物。可以三个人一起吃饭，每个人都有自己的食物喜好。旅馆的菜单每天都会变化，当你选择三人一组时，你可以看到他们对每顿饭的感受。
每个人获得的支持点数取决于他们对这顿饭的喜爱程度，所以不要试图强迫人们吃他们不喜欢的东西。膳食对于与不积极加入你的队伍的人建立支持点特别有帮助，并且是说服新兵加入你的重要方式（稍后会详细介绍），因为你无法在战斗中与他们建立支持。
你最终将解锁竞技场训练，在那里你可以指派两名战士以各种方式相互训练。这将提高双方战士对武器、魔法或动作类型的掌握，同时也为他们提供彼此的支持点。竞技场训练是让角色为更高级的战斗课程做好准备的最有价值的方法。另外，它每周都可用，所以不要忘记每隔一段时间回到 Dagsion 来利用它。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/3-renown-1790796232673.jpg
提高你的声誉

Each protagonist will learn about Renown once they get to Dagsion early in the game, and it’s basically a stat that measures how well known you are in the city. Increasing your Renown adds important boosts at certain thresholds, will make it possible to recruit more characters, and it’s a big part of the central gameplay loop of Fortune’s Weave.

All protagonists can take on subquests given out by people throughout Dagsion, most of which will take you onto the world map to find items or get rid of certain enemies. These subquests each give Renown and all have deadlines, but they’re usually pretty forgiving, so you should have plenty of time to do them all.

Paralogues are the exception to that standard. These are more significant side quests that expand on the stories of individual characters. Fire Emblem veterans will already be familiar with paralogues, but they're handled differently in Fortune's Weave than the rest of the series. You can only start one if you talk to the right character in Dagsion during a set period of time, and the deadlines for paralogues are strict (in the most extreme case, there's one on Dietrich's path you can only get on one specific date).

这可能是一个问题，因为您可能会在世界地图上花费很长一段时间，然后就过了截止日期，甚至没有意识到有旁白可用。您不会收到任何游戏内通知，您只需在正确的日期到达 Dagsion 即可。完成一段旁白可以让你获得 20,000 金币、一堆声望，并解锁某些角色的招募，所以它们非常值得。我通常不建议在指南的帮助下进行游戏，但我认为在这方面最好事先查找信息。您需要了解旁白可用的日期，以便您可以做出相应的计划。幸运的是，IGN 对所有主角的约会进行了完整的细分。
您还可以通过拜访达格森神庙中的神灵来赢得声望。这在游戏早期就可用，但很容易忘记，因为你没有得到提醒。地图上有每个神的神庙的图标。您可能会注意到，在某些日子里，其中一个图标是黄色的，这意味着上帝亲自在那里并且可以拜访。如果你继续与同一个神聊天，他们会和你变得亲密，并可能透露一些关于他们自己或关于世界的知识的额外信息。

While completing subquests and paralogues is the base way everyone can gain Renown, each protagonist also has an additional one that’s unique to them. Cai’s involves doing more quests, called kindness quests. Dietrich can summon enemies to battle at any time, as well as duel combatants in dungeons to steal their combat arts. Theodora gets resource requests that allow her to trade items you’ve gathered for Renown. And for Leda, remember to check the tavern in Dagsion at the start of each chapter. She’ll have new performance requests in certain cities on the world map, where she can dance to receive thousands of gold and hundreds of Renown at once.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/4-materials-1790796294987.jpg
Mind Your Materials

Character levels and class progression are obviously important in Fortune’s Weave, but don’t forget about their equipment. You’ll start with wooden weapons, but the armory will quickly add bronze and iron versions that are significantly more powerful. You should upgrade as soon as you’re able to.

In Chapter 6, regardless of whose path you’re following, you’ll be introduced to the blacksmith. The main one is in Dagsion, but some bigger towns on the world map will have one too. They allow you to spend money and smithing materials to upgrade your weapons, with basic weapons only requiring Smithing Stones and more specialized equipment requiring unique materials.
你可以在世界地图上收集这些材料，但找到它们的最佳地点是矿井。这些地牢里有水晶矿藏，你可以粉碎它们，保证你能获得锻造材料。正如你所期望的，更高级别的矿井将有更多独特的材料，你可以一次收集到一堆。
地下城里也充满了你可以通过攻击粉碎的盒子和桶，而那些装有物品的盒子和桶上会有金色的闪光。你可以通过这种方式获得各种材料，包括石头和食物。

items.title: GTA 6 Should “Blaze A Trail” To More Expensive Games, Dev Says
items.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for its standard edition. Another voice has come forward to say they hope ot

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for its standard edition. Another voice has come forward to say they hope other teams follow suit and charge more for new games to help the industry at a time when developers are closing up shop, cancelling games, and laying off developers on a regular basis.
Martin Klima, the co-founder of Kingdom Come developer Warhorse, told PC Gamer that raising unit prices would "help a lot," but "everybody's scared to death" to do it.

"Now, hopefully, GTA will blaze the trail, and it will allow us to increase the cost," he said, adding that Rockstar and Take-Two are among the only companies who can "afford, or who can dare" to raise prices in this way.
He added that price increases for new games are "long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ambrosia_05_3fee31.jpg?w=636

Take-Two was among the first big publishers to drive prices up from $60 to $70, kicking this off with NBA 2K21 in 2020. Numerous other publishers followed suit, and now $70 is the norm. Defending the price increase, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said production costs increased by 300%.

Former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden said in 2025 that the price of new games should have gone up with every new console generation for the past 20 years. That largely did not happen, and now the industry is worse off for it, he said.

“I think it’s because everyone’s afraid,” he told GI.biz . “No one wants to be the first one to raise the price, because you’re afraid to lose traffic. So what you do is you just end up eating into your operating income, your profit margin.”

“There were more sports cars in the parking lot in the PS1 era than there were in the PS4 era, because if you’re selling 20 million units at $60 for something that only cost you $10 million to make, that’s different than selling 20 million units at $60 for something that cost you $160 million to make.”
To help make up the difference, developers have hawked things like microtransactions, DLC, and battle passes . If more games go up in price, those trends will likely continue, too.
Before GTA 6's price was revealed, a Bank of America stock analyst said Take-Two should charge $80 to help spur other publishers to follow suit .
We already have $80 games, as Nintendo charges $80 for Mario Kart World, saying the game's ambition justifies the price tag .

Every game is priced differently, even within the same publisher, as Take-Two launched Mafia: The Old Country for $50– to great success . For its part, Nintendo's newly released F ire Emblem: Fortune's Weave costs $80 for its physical edition or $70 for its digital counterpart.

GTA 6, which releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, also has a $100 Ultimate Edition and a $400 collector's edition that does not include the game. Zelnick said earlier this year that Rockstar could have leveraged the monumental demand for GTA 6 to c harge a higher price to consumers , but chose not to.

In addition to the mountains of money Rockstar and Take-Two are due to make off GTA 6 game sales, the game is likely to eventually have some kind of new version of GTA Online, and that's no doubt going to print money .

items.summary: Video games are usually a few steps removed from reality, but with Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Gam

content.v: Video games are usually a few steps removed from reality, but with Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Games aims to reflect and amplify the current state of the world with an "over the top" experience. As seen in the trailers and gameplay previews so far, GTA 6 is a contemporary game about doing whatever it takes to make it to the top, and that pursuit of fame and glory is often bookended by shootouts, car chases, and explosions in its Bonnie and Clyde narrative.

"If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today’s world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face," senior VP of narrative Rupert Humphries said to Love Magazine . "Otherwise, you could just go outside and live in the real world."

Humphries also described the world of GTA 6 as "a pressure cooker for all kinds of insanity," as the protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, are polar opposites. Game writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern described Lucina as an ambitious go-getter who'll do anything to get the life she dreams of, while Jason is bound by life's circumstances. "We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other," Gauvey-Kern said.

GTA 6 is also making some big changes to the franchise formula, as getting out of trouble won't be as easy as hiding in an alley and waiting for your wanted level to drop. Actions have consequences, and with the cops being much smarter and more persistent, players will have to be more cunning before they embark on a crime spree. The relationship between Jason and Lucia is also surprisingly more nuanced and deeper than you think, and it'll be a major part of the overall GTA 6 experience when the game launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

With the wait almost over, the marketing machine for GTA 6 has begun to get into gear. Advertising has already taken over a Miami stadium , and the NBA's Miami Heat have announced they'll wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys when they face off against the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18. Rockstar Games also announced a $400 GTA 6 Collector's Edition last week; while it doesn't include the game, it does include various trinkets typically associated with users of the devil's dandruff.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

There is no more room in hell—the dead are at the beach. Grand Theft Auto 5, already burdened and bedraggled by the parade of mods I have inflicted on it, must now contend with a new disorder: revenants from beyond the veil.

I have installed ZombieInfection , which adds zombie and, indeed, infection. In any given populated space, you will look about yourself to notice that some of Los Santos' denizens are more bloody and shambling than usual. This is because they have been rejected by the grave.

Whenever these undead pedestrians brush up against other city-dwellers, the latter converts instantly to the horde. Before long, what began as just two or three bloodied weirdos becomes a city-threatening catastrophe, which is both horrifying and a good way of demonstrating the power of exponential growth.

Fortunately, zombies are just as prone to the impact of tornadoes, cars, fire, and so on as anyone else. They're also rather slow. More often than not, they get taken out by one of Los Santos' countless ambient threats before they can do any real damage. A lesson for mayors everywhere.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2NyD6cHwCabsi97uESHcG-1920-80.gif

Shockingly, the curse of the undeath is so strong that it can somehow break my own aura of immortality. Franklin—you may have noticed from previous articles, where he does things like surviving tornadoes and being used as a ramp by cars—is invincible in my GTA 5 install. But let a zombie brush up against him for long enough and he will succumb to the afterworld like any other mortal. It's very scary. Happy Halloween.

For the second time, and likely the last, Magic: The Gathering has taken players back to Middle-Earth with its The Hobbit set (its fifth of the year, if you can believe it), and it’s been pretty great.

That’s perhaps to be expected since the original book laid out a lot of what we consider fantasy tropes. Dragons, goblins, dwarves, and more are represented here in a smaller set than the Lord of the Rings one, all of which have gone on to inspire Magic cards in their own right.

Still, given how tricky it can be to get some products, there’s a good chance that finding Hobbit items can feel like searching for the Arkenstone in Smaug’s treasure hoard. And yet, it feels like, in a way, that’s kind of the point.
Tolkien Collectors Will Love The Hobbit Set
J.R.R. Tolkien’s influence on the world of fantasy cannot be overstated, and there’s a reason that so many early editions of his works have fetched colossal sums of money.
As an example, back in 2025, a fully signed Lord of the Rings first-edition set sold for around £287,700 (or $337,000). That marks the high point of spending, but it’s not an outlier by any stretch.
An unsigned first edition of the book also sold in 2025 for $250,000, while a collection of manuscripts from the author that includes notes written in Elvish has sold for over $200,000, too.

Naturally, memorabilia sells big, too, notably from Peter Jackson’s iconic movies. Props, costumes, and limited-edition art prints fetch piles of gold to make a covetous dragon blush, and that includes pieces from The Hobbit movies, too.
Of course, those figures are colossal compared to the price of even the most expensive cards in The Hobbit set , but there’s crossover there, too.

Whereas the Lord of the Rings set offered full art cards with a slick border treatment that highlighted the series’ characters across heroes and villains, The Hobbit leans into the series’ literary origins with book cover-inspired designs that carry a “well-read” look that makes them feel unique amongst Magic’s wide-ranging treatment offerings.

This writer was lucky enough to pack Gandalf, Goblins’ Bane and Smaug, Wicked Worm in the treatment, and they’ve almost instantly become two of my favorite Magic cards I own. There’s just something about the way they look textured that makes them feel like the latest in a long line of Tolkien memorabilia.
In fact, I’d go so far as to say that these are my favorite treatments we’ve received in years - and an ideal inclusion for any serious collector.
That doesn’t make it any easier to find the cards, mind…

items.title: 即将推出的关于制作游戏的模拟游戏是如此深入，你的游戏甚至可能会被网络窃听
items.summary: Let's Build a Dungeon isn't just about making a game, but all the stuff you have to deal with while making a g

content.v: Of all the games on the horizon, the one I may be most looking forward to Let's Build a Dungeon . It's a sim from Springloaded, makers of Let's Build a Zoo and the upcoming RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks , and the premise is one we've all mulled at one point or another: what if I could make my own videogame?

And in Let's Build a Dungeon, you can. Dig dungeons, populate them with monsters and traps and loot, design quests, and watch simulated players play your game. You'll even be able to let real players play the game you make.

But there's also the simulation surrounding the game you're building. The development studio you've founded. The devs you hire. You'll have to deal with investors, finances, the public, the press (like me!), crunch, gaming conventions, hackers, and even text messages from your mom.

There's a lot going on in this sim. Like, a lot , a lot. During a recent preview and interview with Springloaded founder and Let's Build a Dungeon lead developer James Barnard , here's what leapt out at me as being the most a lot among the lot.
"We have, like, 700 [fictional] games or something, and the list keeps on getting longer."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UBDi92zSvpGyqKjDn4pfGP-1920-80.jpg
Let's Build a Dungeon lead developer and Springloaded founder

Let's Build a Dungeon simulates Steam's backend and sites like SteamSpy where you can see your game alongside the competition. Lots of competition: Springloaded has invented hundreds of fictional (and unplayable, sadly) games to populate your reality.
"We have all these games, which obviously our concept artist, poor guy, he spent his his whole life drawing these things."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/b9pNeZgsm2zD2ZU9XNWJrC-1920-80.jpg
And look, there's even an advert for a gaming show. A computer gaming show. That's a great idea for an event! Someone should do that for real.

"You can see sort of how your game is doing with the wishlists and things like that. The objective is to get into events, and if you do, you get massive number of impressions. So we really use the impressions, click through rate, conversions, wishlists , and all of that stuff feeds into the chart."

"When you go from CGA to VGA, you have to upgrade some of your computers, and then the size of everything expands and becomes bigger, so suddenly you need more hard drive space because all your assets are now high resolution."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6GcF3WpKQkNsKY3XgcyLvC-1920-80.jpg

The fictional game you're making in Let's Build a Dungeon runs on fictional hardware, and as your game gets bigger, it takes up more space. Time is passing, too, meaning there are advances in PC hardware as well as your game's required specs, and that's reflected in the sim.
" We drew every single component of every computer, so there's about 150 components that we drew from, and it goes through the history of computing."
You won't just see a difference, you'll hear one. The soundtrack of the game will change based on the audio card your simulated computer is using.
Buying plane tickets and booking hotels for your devs to attend game showcases is a "ridiculous minigame" that even simulates layovers
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6xrmEDayb3rTiZTcvWLSsC-1920-80.jpg

"Once [your employees] head off to the [showcase], you get to pick who's going to go to the event, and then they aren't working, so they won't appear in your design board. If I send these two people to an event, they're going to disappear for three days and and, you know, fuck up my schedule.

"The flights kind of curve up in price as you get closer to the day, but then sometimes there'll be a bargain right at the end if they've got too many seats to sell, and the same for the hotel. So if you wait till the last minute, you sort of take this risk of: Am I going to spend too much?

"We calculate where you started your company and where the event is. We actually calculate the distance and how long it takes and we do the stopovers in the right cities , so where your office is, is gonna impact you. So if you get EGX Rezzed, it's just down the road for you, if you pick London."
Remember Cyberleek? That could happen to you
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PpuAiEquGmb7QxjNvFMPG9-1920-80.jpg

"This is some super nerd who's basically hacked your computer. Oh no, he's been following your investors' flights around the world, and he's decided that you are making an MMO, and he's looked at your financials and the other guy's financials, and then he holds you to ransom.
" He's either going to leak the game, or he's or he's going to convince you to put him in the game . There's lots of different outcomes."
Your mum sends you pie recipes and cat videos
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rMw8kQEVkxt7jehojfGMfN-1920-80.jpg
"Your mum calls you. Have you eaten? And then she tries to make you eat different food, and gives you desktop screenshots and things for rewards.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8DZXKNLuZjzrXmqpVHvZQN-1920-80.jpg
"And this conversation, for example, you can get a song, you can get like different desktop images to cheer you up because she wants you to be encouraged in your daily life.

"One of the other things she gives you is a pie, and then she sends you the recipe for the pie, and then you get inspired, and you add a the ability for your designers to come up with a pie recipe, and then you get a pie that you can put in the game , and the players can eat, and you can adjust all that kind of stuff."

By the way, if all of this game dev studio simulation stuff isn't your thing and you just want to use Let's Build a Dungeon to design your own game, you can do that too! There's a campaign mode, build mode, creative mode, or just play the games created by other players.
Let's Build a Dungeon is coming to early access in February . There's a demo you can try in the meantime.

content.v: I am a disastrously untalented individual, but my biggest failure of all? My inability to sew. Holes in clothes? Unpatched. Long trousers? Unhemmed. Thrifts? Unflipped. It is both a pure skill and creativity issue, and I forever look on longingly at those far more talented than myself.

Turns out that extends to one of the hottest new cosy games of 2026, too. Dressmaker has absolutely taken over my life—and the life of many new virtual sewists—with its relaxing yet devilishly moreish garment creation. It's genuinely brilliant, a testament to how good games can be when you zoom in on a niche and go all-in on it.

Sketch dresses with different bodies, skirts, sleeves, collars; doodle in rough colour schemes and lay fabric samples over each other to find the perfect combination. Sift through bolts of silk, lace, linen, cotton, and velvet in an absurd number of colours, before laying out all the parts of your bespoke pattern and sewing them all together. It's brilliant, but I am naff at it. Literally, look at this dress I tried to design with the brief "what if Geralt of Rivia was my client?" in mind.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/br3PfrA8GHUT8VVhoJ7HnJ-1920-80.jpg

Where's the pizzazz, the drama? Thankfully, social media has been blessing me with people who actually understand how to make the most out of Dressmaker's gorgeous adornments and fabrics—for both good and evil. Here are some of my absolute favourites for you to feast your eyes upon:
